newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Richard Pieris up on boardroom battle.
newsitem.headline: Richard Pieris up on boardroom battle.

text.p: Richard Pieris & Co Ltd shares rose 7.7 percent, or 7.25 rupees, to 102 rupees in early Monday trading on a boardroom battle among the group's major shareholders, brokers said.
"There is a battle between two big local shareholders, which regularly drives up the price of the scrip," said a local broker.
In early morning, a total of 229,900 shares were traded, brokers said.
Richard Pieris is a holding company that manufactures and trades in rubber products, household goods and agricultural equipment.
